posts.text: Electric bills are too high. Modernizing our grid and helping families access cleaner, cheaper energy are practical solutions to bring relief. This week, I introduced the ON-DEMAND Act with Reps. Obernolte and Matsui to do just that. https://t.co/6brVA58fCX

In Tampa Bay, we celebrate our heroes. That’s why I was so proud to join my colleagues to force a vote on and PASS the Major Richard Star Act today. This historic legislation will fix the Wounded Warrior Tax, ensuring Veterans receive their full retirement regardless of their https://t.co/UtO5z3qnNE

Happy Veterans Day! 🇺🇸 

Today, we honor the service and sacrifice of those who have served our country. Our Tampa Bay community is rich with Veterans, service members, and their families who deserve to be celebrated every day.

I’m so proud to represent our patriotic community https://t.co/qjb8LVA8Pf

We’re back to work in Washington. I’m laser-focused on lowering the cost of living—ending the costly war in Iran, reining in reckless tariffs, and rooting out the corruption that’s costing you. It’s time for this government to be accountable to its people, not special interests
Read more: https://t.co/8UXqCTivWH

Ahead of Veterans Day, I’m proud to introduce the No Veteran Left Behind: Housing Retention Act of 2026. No veteran should lose their home because they cannot get the care and support they need. Our patriotic Tampa Bay area expects those who served to be able to age with dignity and live safely. 🇺🇸

This bill will give providers more tools to help Veterans manage their health, get to medical appointments and prevent evictions.

Neighbors, open enrollment is happening now ‼️ 

Visit https://t.co/mxlb69xAAR to apply for or update your coverage by Dec. 15. While rates and plans may change for next year, there are options to help you afford your premiums and cover your family. 🩺

Earlier this year, I was proud to stand with our TPA TSA officers to save their jobs from privatization, and to stand with our Tampa Social Security employees to improve their working conditions. I will continue to fight for the hardworking people who keep our community running smoothly! 💪🏼

https://t.co/jfBJ7mIHBM
READ MORE: https://t.co/Nved2VyW8E

This week, I introduced bipartisan legislation with Reps. Soto and Bilirakis to update Tampa and Orlando to have unique locality pay designations. The cost of living in our community has increased rapidly, and hardworking civilian federal employees in Tampa Bay deserve to be compensated fairly and accordingly.

Thank you, neighbors. It is the honor of a lifetime to serve Tampa Bay and Hillsborough County as your Congresswoman. I love my community, and I will continue to stand up to the corruption that’s costing you more. 🙏

Hillsborough Election Day Info: https://t.co/JVvN11LkfZ

Pinellas Election Day Info: https://t.co/gm8VhLsrm9

Neighbors, today is Election Day! Your vote is your voice, and you should use it. 

Vote in-person at your designated precinct by 7 p.m. If you still have your mail-in ballot, bring it with you! 🗳️

Americans are being squeezed from the gas pump to the grocery store and beyond because of the reckless, costly Iran war. Meanwhile, oil companies turn record profits.

The chaos and corruption in Washington needs to end. Our government should serve its people, not the corporations raking in profits as my neighbors struggle to make ends meet. 

https://t.co/3eKIAjGdfI

Dolores Huerta fought for civil liberties, workers and women’s equality. Her legacy will live on through the United Farm Workers and beyond. 

To honor her life and legacy, we’ll continue to fight for her vision for the future and those whose voices need to be amplified. Rest in https://t.co/AuJl4Kop3c

🏡 $939 more for housing costs.
🛒 $310 more for groceries.
⛽️ $655 more for gas.

Extreme politicians’ reckless wars, illegal tariffs, and expensive policies have cost my neighbors ~$4,200. We

Since last year, 16,000 of my neighbors have lost their health coverage to fund massive tax breaks for billionaires. 

Extreme politicians have sold the Big Ugly Bill under the guise of tax cuts for families, but here’s a secret they don’t want you to know: those tax cuts for families are temporary. Their tax breaks for billionaires are permanent, and so are the health care cuts.

You shouldn’t have to choose between health care and groceries while billionaires get giveaways and favors.

Would you look at that… Your electric bills keep climbing while the regulators paid to protect your pocketbook enjoy luxury retreats funded by utility companies. Utility insiders get VIP access. You get stuck with higher bills. 

This corruption will keep costing you until we hold regulators and utility companies accountable.

https://t.co/bvq4UNzgPH

Inflation jumped again in September, outpacing what experts expected. Gas prices have remained steadily above $4/gallon for 158 days consecutively—a new record!
 
Families cannot afford for this to continue. A reckless war in Iran and rampant corruption in Washington are crushing my neighbors, and I won’t stand for it.

Help is available for long-term hurricane recovery via bipartisan disaster aid 
https://t.co/05kobJBGCq https://t.co/kZo9XzA8C9

Lung cancer takes the lives of too many Floridians every year. I'm leading a bipartisan bill to remove red tape and expand access to low-dose CT screening for our at-risk neighbors. 

https://t.co/57XrSyfsdx

It’s been two years since Hurricanes Helene and Milton made landfall within two weeks of each other. Tampa Bay hadn’t experienced such a devastating hurricane season in our lifetimes.

After the storms, I worked alongside my neighbors to clean up and recover. I saw the very best of our community in an incredibly difficult time.

Reflecting on the two years since, I’m proud of our resilience and our action. We care for each other in Tampa Bay, and this anniversary is a good reminder to look out for your neighbors and yourselves. 🙏🏻

❗️Hillsborough County neighbors: Do you know someone still in need of home repair or replacement due to damage caused by Hurricane Helene or Milton? Check out bipartisan disaster aid from Congress helping our neighbors ➡️ https://t.co/DZ4KscZV3L https://t.co/hoQ6WJjOAT

The reckless war in Iran has been actively raising everyday costs for almost 8 months. From the gas pump to the grocery store, families are feeling the squeeze.
 
Congress has taken three bipartisan votes to rein in the conflict, and service members are still being sent into harms way. It’s time to end this war.

Hillsborough neighbors, protect yourself and your family from mosquitoes carrying dengue fever. 🦟 The county has extended its local state of emergency through Oct. 8. 

Drain standing water, wear protective clothing and don’t forget your bug spray! Find out more: https://t.co/jFn1iZPwrl
TODAY is the last day to register to vote in November’s general election! Check your registration and make a plan to vote at https://t.co/yo4LXzLI3A 🗳️

Life already costs too much. You shouldn’t worry that corruption, fraud, and corporate wrongdoing will make it worse. 

The FTC is key to keeping corporations accountable—that’s why I introduced the 21st Century FTC and FTC Autonomy Acts with @JanSchakowsky to strengthen its ability to act and restore civil penalties for first time offenses. I’m committed to restoring the FTC’s autonomy and authority, and I urge Congress to pass this important legislation.

Thanks to @SenatorBaldwin and @RepTomSuozzi for their partnership in keeping our neighbors covered! 

READ MORE: https://t.co/ksorTRwTLH

Families need affordable health coverage, not more economic pain caused by ripping health care away.

I led a resolution to ensure that a predatory rule change to kick 2 million Americans off their health care and send costs soaring does not go into effect. Today, the Senate is voting on its companion to ensure everyone can access health care—not just the wealthy and well-connected.

I’m committed to making health care affordable and accessible, and I’ll work with anyone to get it done, regardless of their party or chamber. I urge my Senate colleagues to pass the resolution.

“Last year, investor-owned utilities made more $ off residents in Florida – more than $6 billion – than any other state despite having fewer customers and lower base rates than other places like CA and NY.” 

Read how extreme FL politicians allow this to happen 😒👇 https://t.co/FxT8eGoR3z

Floridians are losing health coverage faster than anyone else in the country thanks to extreme politicians letting ACA tax credits expire. They’ve created a cost-of-living crisis and put health care out of reach for millions. 

Every week, I hear from my neighbors who have lost coverage or are being crushed by its high prices—I’m committed to ensuring that health care is affordable and accessible to all who need it. You shouldn’t have to choose between doctors visits and paying your electric bills.
👏Yes!!! #RaysUp https://t.co/1HbbcTbs9V

Tomorrow, women of Congress from both parties take the field for the 18th annual Congressional Women’s Softball Game! 🥎

This year, I’m proud to be playing for my neighbor Nelcy Baltz. She’s a breast cancer survivor and a small business owner who started her own breast cancer nonprofit—a perfect representation of what our bipartisan game is all about. 💕💪🏼 #CWSG2026 @CWSoftballGame
@TalMorgan1991 Yes + Tampa Bay Chamber, SOCOM and CENTCOM working with me to boost locality pay https://t.co/5knULTh2Bk

I’m proud to have secured millions of federal dollars in storm recovery for my neighbors. The $709 million fund is currently accepting applications for Hillsborough County residents, supporting long-term investment in recovery and resilience for neighbors affected by hurricanes Helene and Milton.

Apply today: https://t.co/m22T4xyhn4

Extreme politicians are ending the Medicare Part D Premium Stabilization initiative early, raising prescription prices for seniors. Life is already expensive enough, and seniors shouldn’t have to choose between their life-saving medications and their groceries.

This week, I introduced the Affordable Premiums for Seniors Act with Rep. Sewell to keep premiums down and provide greater certainty on health care costs for our seniors, who have worked hard for their earned Medicare benefits.

Today, the House PASSED my Ratepayer Protection Act! 

This bill ensures that Big Tech foots the bill for hyper scale data centers—not consumers. Electric bills are already sky-high, and my bipartisan Ratepayer Protection Act is an important first step that can help lower costs for my neighbors and empower states to set additional, strict guardrails.
@SVadaparampil Thank you!

Today, we launch the Thriving Economy Project! As Chair of the project, I’ve worked alongside incredible members and policy experts to develop an innovative action plan to guide thoughtful economic development and prepare us for the future. 🌎

The project contains policies to lower costs, support sustainable growth and build safer communities. The chapter on Thriving, Affordable, and Resilient Communities is particularly personal to me as Tampa Bay’s Congresswoman. I’m proud to lead it and excited for you to see what we’ve been working on. @SEEC 

View the project here: https://t.co/sj5YpKiubB

Fossil-fueled power plants are expensive, dirty, and make our communities sicker. The EPA’s rollback of life-saving pollution limits is a dangerous, corrupt decision that gives handouts to Big Oil and Gas and does nothing to lower your costs.

A healthy and affordable future for our communities depends on holding polluters accountable and building cheaper, cleaner, more reliable energy—not prolonging the lives of outdated power plants.
